summary: During an active authenticated lifespan, 24 logger namespaces including root and an unrelated third-party name, with handlers attached after lifespan entry, are checked for exact '[redacted]' in msg, args, mapping args, split-token args, nested extra keys/values, exc_text, and stack_info at both formatted-output and raw-record levels; a standard field name equal to a token is verified not to be renamed.
